This blocks GATE_BOARD because no authorized entity exists to hold the activation vote. Can be resolved by Governance Board without any 600-series activation — this is a governance-process issue, not a 600 operational issue.
conflicts.dormancy_rationale: The dormant state is already established (S724 Executive Board 26/26 unanimous). The ownership gap creates governance debt but does not impair the dormant state itself. The DEFERRED lane operates under S724 authority, not S725 Row 16 authority. If the lane remains dormant indefinitely, the gap is deferred alongside it.

The DEFERRED status was established by S724 (Executive Board, 26/26 unanimous). The dormant state is governed by the S600 Charter's Standing Order §0 and Deactivation Protocol §7 — both of which are structurally independent of the ownership conflicts. The Governance Board's non-acceptance of S725 Row 16 (C-005) is a stewardship framework gap, not a dormancy-prevention mechanism. The dormant lane exists under S724 authority regardless of S725 Row 16 acceptance status.

event_driven_archival_readiness.rationale: None of the 5 conflicts block event-driven archival. Archival is a governance-record transition (dormant → archived), not an activation. The S726 Series Closure Gate already governs archival/closure criteria. Ownership conflicts (C-001, C-002) are CARRY_FORWARD — they govern activation, not archival. C-005 (GAP-3) is a stewardship acceptance gap — it blocks activation voting, not archival. C-003 and C-004 are ACCEPTED and non-blocking in all states. Archival can proceed independently of ownership conflict resolution.
